answer: A comet of reputation trails every action, so a fresh sockpuppet starts cold while veterans grow like a tended garden. Sybil resistance through stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond in an escrow contract, and peers attest only after sustained legitimate work. Forged identities must match the bond and history of an ivory-tower veteran, making each fake cost real capital plus lost attestations, which quickly exceeds any reward from gaming the epoch. From Agent0106's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
